title: Sample-Efficient Ensemble Reinforcement Learning at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.19733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ensemble methods such as MeanQ have been shown to improve the sample efficiency of relatively small model-free deep reinforcement learning (RL) architectures, including DQN and similarly sized variants such as Rainbow. However, to our knowledge, the effects of ensembling on large-scale architectures such as Bigger Better Faster (BBF) have not been studied. In this work, we present MeanQ-BBF, a hybrid model-free algorithm that combines the principles of MeanQ and BBF. Through statistically rigorous evaluation on the Atari 100K benchmark, we show that in contrast to naive scaling of the network size of BBF, which degrades performance, MeanQ-BBF is able to leverage the increase in model capacity to improve performance over BBF. Moreover, MeanQ-BBF does this in a computationally efficient way by organizing the added parameters into largely independent learners. translated_title: 大规模样本高效的集成强化学习
translated_abstract: 集成方法（如MeanQ）已被证明可以提高相对较小的无模型深度强化学习（RL）架构的样本效率，包括DQN和类似规模的变体（如Rainbow）。然而，据我们所知，集成对大规模架构（如Bigger Better Faster，即BBF）的影响尚未被研究。在这项工作中，我们提出了MeanQ-BBF，一种结合了MeanQ和BBF原理的混合无模型算法。通过在Atari 100K基准上进行统计严谨的评估，我们表明：与单纯扩大BBF网络规模会导致性能下降相反，MeanQ-BBF能够利用模型容量的增加来提升性能，超越BBF。此外，MeanQ-BBF通过将新增参数组织成基本相互独立的学习器，以计算高效的方式实现这一点。最后，我们在实际采样预算的背景下讨论了性能与成本的权衡。
tldr: 该论文提出MeanQ-BBF混合算法，将MeanQ集成方法与大规模BBF架构相结合，在Atari 100K基准上以计算高效的方式利用模型容量提升，实现了超越BBF的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MeanQ-BBF, a hybrid algorithm combining MeanQ ensemble methods with the large-scale BBF architecture, which leverages increased model capacity in a computationally efficient way to outperform BBF on the Atari 100K benchmark.
